name: wkea-manage-cli
description: WKEA 后台管理 CLI 工具

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist/docs',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('docs','dist/docs',{recursive:true})" && npm run pack
scripts.pack: rm -f wkea-cli-skill.zip && 7z a -tzip wkea-cli-skill.zip dist/ SKILL.md AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json
